title: Graphing a Horizontally Shifted Absolute Value Function
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Analyze and describe the graph of y = |x - 2| by identifying its parent function, transformation, vertex, domain, range, and intercepts.

steps.title: Identify the Parent Function and Horizontal Shift
steps.explanation: Starting from the V-shaped parent graph y = |x| with vertex at (0, 0), replacing x with x - 2 shifts the graph 2 units to the right.
steps.why: Replacing x with x - 2 translates every point (x, y) to (x + 2, y).

steps.title: Write the Piecewise Linear Branches and Vertex
steps.explanation: The sharp corner (vertex) occurs where x - 2 = 0, namely at (2, 0). To the left of x = 2 the graph is a ray of slope -1, and to the right of x = 2 it is a ray of slope +1.
steps.why: By definition of absolute value, |u| = -u for u < 0 and |u| = u for u >= 0.

steps.title: State the Domain, Range, and Intercepts
steps.explanation: The function is defined for all real x and outputs all non-negative real numbers, touching the x-axis at (2, 0) and crossing the y-axis at (0, 2).
steps.why: Absolute value is non-negative for all real inputs and attains 0 at x = 2.
